summary.text: Eric Barlow is a Republican state senator from Gillette, a Marine Corps veteran, large-animal veterinarian and rancher. He served in the Wyoming House from 2013 to 2023, including as Speaker in 2021–2022, and chairs the Senate Labor, Health and Social Services Committee. His platform emphasizes cash-based budgeting, healthcare access and public lands.

paragraphs.text: Fourth-generation Wyomingite raised on his family's ranch in Campbell County; U.S. Marine Corps veteran; D.V.M. from Colorado State University.
Served in the Wyoming House (District 3) from 2013 to 2023, including as Majority Leader (2019–2021) and Speaker (2021–2023).
Elected to the Wyoming Senate in 2022; chairs the Senate Labor, Health and Social Services Committee.
